**Issue #3546 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3546: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E4, GIGA
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds **GIGA**: a permanent two lanes wide in both rows, in both lanes for every rule that reads a lane, and the mark that makes a card GIGA from the hand or on embiggen.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **GIGA**
  * **GIGA** applies to permanents. They make them 2x2 (visually and actually) taking up two backrow and two unit lanes. It can be applied to traps field spells and units. It is technically part of both lanes basically making it twice as susceptible to cleave and can be lane eated in anything else.
  * You have a lot of freedom to design this but the main thing is that they are supposed to be BIG.
```

## The build (defaults from SP3; change one only with a ruling note)

- A GIGA permanent takes two adjacent lanes in both the unit row and the backrow, four zones. The player picks its left lane as they play it. **Default:** it can be played or summoned only where all four zones are free (or are made free by its own placement rules, as Crater does). When it can't fit, a summon fails and a play is not offered.
- It is in both lanes for every rule that reads a lane: attacks across, Cleave, lane effects, "this lane and adjacent", and later E7's Black Hole and slashed board. An effect that hits each lane once hits it once per lane. A Unit's own attack is made once.
- Making a card GIGA is a mark that carries from the hand onto the field ("Make a permanent in your hand GIGA", "Draw … and make them GIGA"). "Embiggen: GIGA" means the card becomes GIGA when embiggened.

## The cards that will use it

S08 (#106 Spectre, the four Walls, #23 GIGA-ify, #99 Big Time Recruits, #100 Plesiosize), S10 (#56 Impact Reactor), S11 (#52, #53 the drills), S24 (Call to Chaos), and later E7's Black Hole and slashed board.

## The client

The board's layout draws a GIGA permanent across its four zones (`apps/web`, `Game.tsx`'s layers: one owning module each), and drag-to-play offers only the left lanes where it fits. Add a web unit test, and a screenshot in a comment on this issue (the `ui-walkthrough` skill).

## Done when

- [ ] The mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§3, §4, §6, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] It is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`), with no card yet: the cards come in their own parts.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client renders it.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `pnpm --dir apps/web test` pass.
- [ ] Nothing changes for players: no shipped card reaches it.

Blocked by #3543

Part of #3534.
````

## Goal

A GIGA permanent stands in its **anchor**, lane L of its own row, and **covers** the other row's zone in lane L and both rows' zones in lane L+1. Nothing else enters those four zones, it is played only where all four fit, a summon that can't fit fails, and every lane rule reads it in both its lanes.

It is GIGA if it has the keyword as it enters the field: printed, granted in a hand (the mark), or from an embiggen `conditional_keywords` hook. Its size is then fixed until it leaves.

The view carries `giga` and the client draws the card across all four zones, with rulings R3546000–R3546004, fixture tests and no card change.

## Steps

1. **`config.rs`.** Add `pub const GIGA_LANES: i32 = 2;` ("R3546000: the lanes a GIGA permanent spans in each row").

2. **`state.rs`.** Add `CardInstance.giga: Option<bool>` after `enters_evolved`, with `evolved`'s attributes, documented "R3546000: fills four zones; stamped as it enters the field, fixed there, taken off by R78's reset". Set `giga: None` in `new_instance` and in any literal the compiler names.

3. **New `giga.rs`.** It never calls `zones::is_empty`.
   - `is_giga(card)`: `giga == Some(true)`.
   - `enters_giga(state, card)`: `layers::unit_has(state, card, KeywordKind::Giga)`.
   - `lanes_of(card) -> Vec<i32>`: on the field, `lane..lane + GIGA_LANES` if `is_giga`, else `[lane]`. Off the field, `[]`.
   - `spanned_slots(anchor) -> Option<Vec<ZoneSlot>>`: the anchor, then the other row in the same lane, then both rows of the next lane. `None` past `row_size`.
   - `covering(state, slot) -> Option<&CardInstance>`: the GIGA top among `card_at` at anchor lanes `max(1, lane − GIGA_LANES + 1)..=lane`, both rows of `slot.player`, whose span holds `slot`.
   - `occupant_at(state, slot)`: `card_at`, else `covering` when that card's own row is `slot.row`.
   - `fits(anchor, room: impl Fn(ZoneSlot) -> bool)`: true when every spanned slot passes `room`.
   - `first_anchor(player, row, room)`: the leftmost lane that fits.
   - `entry_anchor(state, player, row)`: `first_anchor` with `is_open`, else with `takes_move`.
   - `adjacent_slots(state, card)`: the card's side and row at lanes `min(lanes_of) − 1` and `max + 1`, kept only if on the board.
   - `lanes_meet(a, b)`: some lane of `a` is in `lanes_of(b)`.
   - `lands_whole(state, card, to)`: `!is_giga(card) || fits(to, |s| takes_move(state, s))`.

4. **`lib.rs` and `prelude.rs`.** Add `pub mod giga;` to `lib.rs`. Add `pub use crate::giga::{enters_giga, is_giga, lanes_of, occupant_at};` to `prelude.rs`.

5. **`zones.rs`.**
   - `is_empty`: also require `covering(..).is_none()`.
   - `accepts_stack_card`: `false` when covered. This also stops an Equip onto a GIGA, since `equip_host_at` checks it first.
   - `place_with`, after the reservation check:
     - Return `false` if `covering` names another card.
     - Set `let giga = if instance.zone.z() == ZoneName::Field { is_giga(instance) } else { enters_giga(state, instance) };`.
     - If `giga`, return `false` unless `fits(slot, |s| is_empty(state, s) && !is_reserved(state, s))`.
     - Set `instance.giga = giga.then_some(true)` before `placed`.
   - `reset_instance`: `instance.giga = None`.
   - `replace_in_zone`: `replacement.giga = old.giga`.
   - `flicker_in_place`: `live.giga = current.giga` after the reset.
   - `step_into_unit_zone` and `step_into_backrow`: return `false` for a GIGA.
   - `testkit/scenario.rs` `place_one` builds its card in a field zone already, so before placing set `card.giga = enters_giga(..).then_some(true)`.

6. **`play_choices.rs`.**
   - `legal_zones_for`, after the `needs_zone` return: when `enters_giga`, the lanes of `row_for_card` whose anchor fits with `is_open(s) || freed_by_tribute(state, &s, tributes)`.
   - `default_zone_for`: `first_anchor` with `is_open`, then with that predicate.
   - `refuse_zone`, after `if !needs`: when `enters_giga`, `Ok` only for a zone `legal_zones_for` lists; else refuse with `"{name} is GIGA: it needs that lane and the next free in both rows"`.
   - To make "Embiggen: GIGA" visible:
     - the listing loop passes `&probe` to `legal_zones_for`;
     - refusal (c) passes `&cheapest.probe` to `default_zone_for` and `legal_zones_for`;
     - `why_choices_refused` passes `&stamped` to `refuse_zone`.

7. **`play_steps.rs`.**
   - Add `PlayRun.giga_zones: Option<Vec<ZoneRef>>` (serde default, skip when `None`).
   - At R210's `reserve_zone`, a GIGA also reserves and stores its other spanned slots; `place_card` releases them.
   - A cast's zone uses `first_anchor(.., is_open)` for a GIGA.

8. **`effects/summon.rs`.**
   - `entry_zone` and `zone_and_stance_for` gain `giga: bool`. Without a lane, a GIGA uses `entry_anchor` (not standing); a named lane must fit with `takes_move`.
   - What each caller passes:
     - `zone_for`: `false`.
     - `summon_fresh`: `enters_giga(&probe)`.
     - `summon_existing`: `enters_giga` of `card` cloned with the `at.radiant`/`at.x` riders. It must equal what `place_with` reads, or the card is lost.
     - `summon_copy`: `enters_giga(&source)`.
     - `summon_lands`: `enters_giga(card)`.

9. **`effects/steal.rs`.** `destination_for` takes the card; a GIGA takes the same lane if it fits with `is_open`, else `entry_anchor`. `capture` returns before removal when the target or the holder is GIGA.

10. **`rotation.rs` and `swap.rs`.** `rotate_rings` places the non-GIGA entries first, then the GIGA ones, bouncing (as for a reserved destination) any that fail `can_accept` or `lands_whole`. `swap_board_now` bounces an entry that fails `lands_whole`.

11. **`state_check.rs`.** Add `RebornEntry.giga_zones`. At R64's `reserve_zone(at)`, when `is_giga(&card.snapshot)`, reserve and store the other spanned slots. `reborn_step` releases them first in each entry's iteration.

12. **The lane readers.**
    - Neighbours: in `combat::cleave`, `lethal::struck_by`, `damage::adjacent_units_of`, `targets::adjacent_to_with` and `query::redirect_neighbours`, `zones::adjacent(at)` becomes `giga::adjacent_slots(state, card)`, and `card_at` becomes `occupant_at`. Drop bindings left unused.
    - `lane_multiplier_for` and Top Loser (`restrictions.rs:236`): the lane equality becomes `lanes_meet`.
    - `in_gauntlet`: true when any of `lanes_of` is in `GAUNTLET_LANES`.
    - `lane_is_empty`: use `zones::is_empty`.
    - `locks.rs`: `lane_of` returns `Vec<i32>` (`lanes_of` for a card), and `lock_lane` tests `contains`.
    - `offer_to_lane_watches`: test the placed card's `lanes_of` when it is GIGA.

13. **The view.** Add `giga: Option<bool>` (`ts(optional, type = "true")`) to `UnitView`, `PublicBackrowView` and `FaceDownBackrowView`, documented "R3546004: fills this zone, the other row's here and both of the next lane's, which the view leaves empty; public, face-down too". Set it from the instance in `unit_view_of` and in both branches of `backrow_view`. On both Giga docs in `catalog_types.rs`, append "R3546000: two lanes wide in both rows (`giga.rs`)".

14. **The docs.** Add a `giga.rs` line after `afflictions.rs` in the engine README. Append an E1-style bullet to SURFACE.md naming every new field and prelude read, with "absent unless set, so old games hash the same".

15. **The rulings.** Notes `spec/rulings/R354600N.md` in R3543000's format.
    - `cards` ends `; Stinkyscape+ (issue #3534)`.
    - `proven_in` is `crates/engine/tests/rules/giga.rs`, plus `apps/web/src/game/giga.test.tsx` for R3546004.
    - Each also gets a `**[[R354600N]] <title> (issue #3546, 2026-11-10)**: … Rejected: …` paragraph in `spec/pending/3546.md`.

    The five rulings:
    - **R3546000 "A GIGA permanent fills four zones"**: only fitting anchors are offered, Tribute-freed zones counting (R391); a Unit anchors in its unit row despite Flexible; a summon takes the leftmost fit (R64, R688) or a named lane that fits, else fails; nothing stacks, equips or captures with it. Rejected: storing it in four zones.
    - **R3546001 "In both its lanes for every rule that reads a lane in its row"**: step 12's list; a GIGA beside the target is hit once; a lane walk meets it once per lane; it attacks once. Rejected: both rows (a Cleave would hit a GIGA Field Spell).

16. **The spec sections.** Edit these, each linking its ruling:

    - §4.2 step 2: Top Loser and the Gauntlet. §4.3: lane strike. §4.4 step 10: Cleave.

    - §10.1: after `entersEvolved?`, add `giga?: true; // fills four zones, stamped as it enters the field (issue #3546, R3546000)`.
    - §10.5 step 4 and §10.8 (after the Evolved bullet): a clause each.

17. **The glossary.**
    - `glossary.json`, after Flexible: `{"id":"GIGA","label":"GIGA","rule":"Fills two adjacent lanes in both rows, four zones, and is in both lanes for every rule that reads one","section":"§6.1","aliases":[]}`.
    - `chinese-terms.json`, `terms`: `"GIGA": "巨型"`.
    - `chinese-terms.json`, glossary: `"GIGA": { "label": "巨型", "rule": "占据相邻两条纵列的单位区与后场区共四个区域，并同时属于这两条纵列" }`.

18. **The web.**
    - **`giga.ts`.** Export `GigaCell = "anchor" | "covered"` and `gigaCellOf(view, side, row, lane)`.
      - Read `sideView(view, side)`. A zone is marked when its unit or backrow entry has `giga === true`.
      - Return `"anchor"` when this zone is marked; `"covered"` when the other row in this lane, or either row in `lane − 1`, is marked; else `null`.
    - **`Zone.tsx`.** Add `data-giga={gigaCellOf(view, side, row, lane) ?? undefined}`.
    - **`board.css`** (a block commented R3546004):
      - `.lane:has(> .zone[data-giga="anchor"])` gets `z-index: calc(var(--z-content) + 1)`.
      - The anchor's `> .card` gets `position: absolute; left: 0; width: calc(200% + var(--gap)); height: calc(200% + var(--gap)); max-width: none; aspect-ratio: auto`.

      - Covered zones get a transparent border and background.

## Risks

- **Replays.** Every new field is skipped when `None`, and the rotation's second pass is empty without a GIGA, so hashes and the golden fold hold.
- **Lost cards.** Every mover checks the fit before it removes a card. The `summon_existing` probe must match the placed card.

- **Speed.** `is_empty` is hot, so `covering` stays a few indexed reads.
- **The base is red for reasons outside this work.**
  - `cargo jackioh spec check` reports 238 problems on 52d311799a: R3535000–R3535002 have no notes (#3535), and R3539000's `proven_in` is wrong.
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` fails in 29 files.
  - Report both by name and add nothing to either.

## Open questions

- **A person must post the screenshot** the issue asks for, since the bot has no GitHub access. The builder takes it with `ui-walkthrough` if a board holding S+ #106 Spectre can be set up, and says where it saved it.
- **Shipped scripts that read a lane through `card_at`** (Classic #71 Lane Eater, the designer's "lane eated") see a GIGA in its anchor lane only. Moving them onto `occupant_at` is a later card part's job.
- **S24's "summon … make them GIGA"** needs a summon rider, which this does not build.
- **The GIGA chip and icon** are S26's.

## Goal

A GIGA permanent stands in its **anchor**, lane L of its own row, and **covers** the other row's zone in lane L and both rows' zones in lane L+1. Nothing else enters those four zones, it is played only where all four fit, a summon that can't fit fails, and every lane rule reads it in both its lanes.

It is GIGA if it has the keyword as it enters the field: printed, granted in a hand (the mark), or from an embiggen `conditional_keywords` hook. Its size is then fixed until it leaves.

The view carries `giga` and the client draws the card across all four zones, with rulings R3546000–R3546004, fixture tests and no card change.

The governing sections are §3, §4.2–§4.5, §6.1 and §10. The work reads rulings R14, R15, R64, R88, R210, R391, R688, R1283, R1849005 and R1878001.

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/`, `catalog.json`, `crates/ai/`, `apps/web/src/wire/catalog.ts`, `keywordMarks.ts`, the `KEYWORD_VISUALS` entries, `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`.

## Steps

1. **`config.rs`.** Add `pub const GIGA_LANES: i32 = 2;` ("R3546000: the lanes a GIGA permanent spans in each row").

2. **`state.rs`.** Add `CardInstance.giga: Option<bool>` after `enters_evolved`, with `evolved`'s attributes, documented "R3546000: fills four zones; stamped as it enters the field, fixed there, taken off by R78's reset". Set `giga: None` in `new_instance` and in any literal the compiler names.

3. **New `giga.rs`.** It never calls `zones::is_empty`.
   - `is_giga(card)`: `giga == Some(true)`.
   - `enters_giga(state, card)`: `layers::unit_has(state, card, KeywordKind::Giga)`.
   - `lanes_of(card) -> Vec<i32>`: on the field, `lane..lane + GIGA_LANES` if `is_giga`, else `[lane]`. Off the field, `[]`.
   - `spanned_slots(anchor) -> Option<Vec<ZoneSlot>>`: the anchor, then the other row in the same lane, then both rows of the next lane. `None` past `row_size`.
   - `covering(state, slot) -> Option<&CardInstance>`: the GIGA top among `card_at` at anchor lanes `max(1, lane − GIGA_LANES + 1)..=lane`, both rows of `slot.player`, whose span holds `slot`.
   - `occupant_at(state, slot)`: `card_at`, else `covering` when that card's own row is `slot.row`.
   - `fits(anchor, room: impl Fn(ZoneSlot) -> bool)`: true when every spanned slot passes `room`.
   - `first_anchor(player, row, room)`: the leftmost lane that fits.
   - `entry_anchor(state, player, row)`: `first_anchor` with `is_open`, else with `takes_move`.
   - `adjacent_slots(state, card)`: the card's side and row at lanes `min(lanes_of) − 1` and `max + 1`, kept only if on the board.
   - `lanes_meet(a, b)`: some lane of `a` is in `lanes_of(b)`.
   - `lands_whole(state, card, to)`: `!is_giga(card) || fits(to, |s| takes_move(state, s))`.

4. **`lib.rs` and `prelude.rs`.** Add `pub mod giga;` to `lib.rs`. Add `pub use crate::giga::{enters_giga, is_giga, lanes_of, occupant_at};` to `prelude.rs`.

5. **`zones.rs`.**
   - `is_empty`: also require `covering(..).is_none()`.
   - `accepts_stack_card`: `false` when covered. This also stops an Equip onto a GIGA, since `equip_host_at` checks it first.
   - `place_with`, after the reservation check:
     - Return `false` if `covering` names another card.
     - Set `let giga = if instance.zone.z() == ZoneName::Field { is_giga(instance) } else { enters_giga(state, instance) };`.
     - If `giga`, return `false` unless `fits(slot, |s| is_empty(state, s) && !is_reserved(state, s))`.
     - Set `instance.giga = giga.then_some(true)` before `placed`.
   - `reset_instance`: `instance.giga = None`.
   - `replace_in_zone`: `replacement.giga = old.giga`.
   - `flicker_in_place`: `live.giga = current.giga` after the reset.
   - `step_into_unit_zone` and `step_into_backrow`: return `false` for a GIGA.
   - `testkit/scenario.rs` `place_one` builds its card in a field zone already, so before placing set `card.giga = enters_giga(..).then_some(true)`.

6. **`play_choices.rs`.**
   - `legal_zones_for`, after the `needs_zone` return: when `enters_giga`, the lanes of `row_for_card` whose anchor fits with `is_open(s) || freed_by_tribute(state, &s, tributes)`.
   - `default_zone_for`: `first_anchor` with `is_open`, then with that predicate.
   - `refuse_zone`, after `if !needs`: when `enters_giga`, `Ok` only for a zone `legal_zones_for` lists; else refuse with `"{name} is GIGA: it needs that lane and the next free in both rows"`.
   - To make "Embiggen: GIGA" visible:
     - the listing loop passes `&probe` to `legal_zones_for`;
     - refusal (c) passes `&cheapest.probe` to `default_zone_for` and `legal_zones_for`;
     - `why_choices_refused` passes `&stamped` to `refuse_zone`.

7. **`play_steps.rs`.**
   - Add `PlayRun.giga_zones: Option<Vec<ZoneRef>>` (serde default, skip when `None`).
   - At R210's `reserve_zone`, a GIGA also reserves and stores its other spanned slots; `place_card` releases them.
   - A cast's zone uses `first_anchor(.., is_open)` for a GIGA.

8. **`effects/summon.rs`.**
   - `entry_zone` and `zone_and_stance_for` gain `giga: bool`. Without a lane, a GIGA uses `entry_anchor` (not standing); a named lane must fit with `takes_move`.
   - What each caller passes:
     - `zone_for`: `false`.
     - `summon_fresh`: `enters_giga(&probe)`.
     - `summon_existing`: `enters_giga` of `card` cloned with the `at.radiant`/`at.x` riders. It must equal what `place_with` reads, or the card is lost.
     - `summon_copy`: `enters_giga(&source)`.
     - `summon_lands`: `enters_giga(card)`.

9. **`effects/steal.rs`.** `destination_for` takes the card; a GIGA takes the same lane if it fits with `is_open`, else `entry_anchor`. `capture` returns before removal when the target or the holder is GIGA.

10. **`rotation.rs` and `swap.rs`.** `rotate_rings` places the non-GIGA entries first, then the GIGA ones, bouncing (as for a reserved destination) any that fail `can_accept` or `lands_whole`. `swap_board_now` bounces an entry that fails `lands_whole`.

11. **`state_check.rs`.** Add `RebornEntry.giga_zones`. At R64's `reserve_zone(at)`, when `is_giga(&card.snapshot)`, reserve and store the other spanned slots. `reborn_step` releases them first in each entry's iteration.

12. **The lane readers.**
    - Neighbours: in `combat::cleave`, `lethal::struck_by`, `damage::adjacent_units_of`, `targets::adjacent_to_with` and `query::redirect_neighbours`, `zones::adjacent(at)` becomes `giga::adjacent_slots(state, card)`, and `card_at` becomes `occupant_at`. Drop bindings left unused.
    - `lane_multiplier_for` and Top Loser (`restrictions.rs:236`): the lane equality becomes `lanes_meet`.
    - `in_gauntlet`: true when any of `lanes_of` is in `GAUNTLET_LANES`.
    - `lane_is_empty`: use `zones::is_empty`.
    - `locks.rs`: `lane_of` returns `Vec<i32>` (`lanes_of` for a card), and `lock_lane` tests `contains`.
    - `offer_to_lane_watches`: test the placed card's `lanes_of` when it is GIGA.

13. **The view.** Add `giga: Option<bool>` (`ts(optional, type = "true")`) to `UnitView`, `PublicBackrowView` and `FaceDownBackrowView`, documented "R3546004: fills this zone, the other row's here and both of the next lane's, which the view leaves empty; public, face-down too". Set it from the instance in `unit_view_of` and in both branches of `backrow_view`. On both Giga docs in `catalog_types.rs`, append "R3546000: two lanes wide in both rows (`giga.rs`)".

14. **The docs.** Add a `giga.rs` line after `afflictions.rs` in the engine README. Append an E1-style bullet to SURFACE.md naming every new field and prelude read, with "absent unless set, so old games hash the same".

15. **The rulings.** Notes `spec/rulings/R354600N.md` in R3543000's format.
    - `cards` ends `; Stinkyscape+ (issue #3534)`.
    - `proven_in` is `crates/engine/tests/rules/giga.rs`, plus `apps/web/src/game/giga.test.tsx` for R3546004.
    - Each also gets a `**[[R354600N]] <title> (issue #3546, 2026-11-10)**: … Rejected: …` paragraph in `spec/pending/3546.md`.

    The five rulings:
    - **R3546000 "A GIGA permanent fills four zones"**: only fitting anchors are offered, Tribute-freed zones counting (R391); a Unit anchors in its unit row despite Flexible; a summon takes the leftmost fit (R64, R688) or a named lane that fits, else fails; nothing stacks, equips or captures with it. Rejected: storing it in four zones.
    - **R3546001 "In both its lanes for every rule that reads a lane in its row"**: step 12's list; a GIGA beside the target is hit once; a lane walk meets it once per lane; it attacks once. Rejected: both rows (a Cleave would hit a GIGA Field Spell).
    - **R3546002 "GIGA is a size taken as the card enters the field"**: printed, hand grant or embiggened conditional keyword (R1878001); fixed on the field; R78's reset ends it; Flicker and Transform keep it. Rejected: a size following field keywords; a separate mark field.
    - **R3546003 "A GIGA moves only whole"**: steal to the same lane, else the leftmost fit, else fails (R15); a rotation (R14) or swap (R88) that can't land it whole bounces it; it never steps rows; Reborn and R210 hold four zones. Rejected: splitting it at the center line.
    - **R3546004 "The view draws a GIGA at its anchor"**: the flag, covered zones empty; public face-down, its zones refusing every play anyway (R33). Rejected: hiding a face-down size.

16. **The spec sections.** Edit these, each linking its ruling:
    - §3.1 (R3546001) and §3.2 (R3546000, R3546003).
    - §4.2 step 2: Top Loser and the Gauntlet. §4.3: lane strike. §4.4 step 10: Cleave.
    - §6.1: a row after Flexible. Columns: `GIGA` | "Fills two adjacent lanes in both rows, four zones" | the rulings in short | `S+ #23, #52, #53, #56, #64–#67, #99, #100, #106, #142`.
    - §10.1: after `entersEvolved?`, add `giga?: true; // fills four zones, stamped as it enters the field (issue #3546, R3546000)`.
    - §10.5 step 4 and §10.8 (after the Evolved bullet): a clause each.

17. **The glossary.**
    - `glossary.json`, after Flexible: `{"id":"GIGA","label":"GIGA","rule":"Fills two adjacent lanes in both rows, four zones, and is in both lanes for every rule that reads one","section":"§6.1","aliases":[]}`.
    - `chinese-terms.json`, `terms`: `"GIGA": "巨型"`.
    - `chinese-terms.json`, glossary: `"GIGA": { "label": "巨型", "rule": "占据相邻两条纵列的单位区与后场区共四个区域，并同时属于这两条纵列" }`.

18. **The web.**
    - **`giga.ts`.** Export `GigaCell = "anchor" | "covered"` and `gigaCellOf(view, side, row, lane)`.
      - Read `sideView(view, side)`. A zone is marked when its unit or backrow entry has `giga === true`.
      - Return `"anchor"` when this zone is marked; `"covered"` when the other row in this lane, or either row in `lane − 1`, is marked; else `null`.
    - **`Zone.tsx`.** Add `data-giga={gigaCellOf(view, side, row, lane) ?? undefined}`.
    - **`board.css`** (a block commented R3546004):
      - `.lane:has(> .zone[data-giga="anchor"])` gets `z-index: calc(var(--z-content) + 1)`.
      - The anchor's `> .card` gets `position: absolute; left: 0; width: calc(200% + var(--gap)); height: calc(200% + var(--gap)); max-width: none; aspect-ratio: auto`.
      - It gets `top: 0` for your units and the enemy backrow, `bottom: 0` for the other two.
      - Covered zones get a transparent border and background.
    - **`MinionFace.tsx:100` and `keywordVisuals.ts:393`.** `KEYWORD_VISUALS[kind]?.onField === true`, so a kind with no visual draws nothing instead of crashing.

19. **Regenerate.** Run the full `ts` test and keep the `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` diff.

## Tests

Fixtures go in `crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/giga.rs`, in E3's `card()` and `register_*` pattern: `register_giga_fixtures`, indices from 35460, every card costing (0).

| Constant | Id | The card |
|---|---|---|
| `GIGA_UNIT` | `giga-unit` | 2/6 Unit, `[GIGA]` |
| `GIGA_FIELD` | `giga-field` | Field Spell, `[GIGA]` |
| `PLAIN` | `giga-plain` | 1/3 Unit |
| `CLEAVER` | `giga-cleaver` | 3/8 Unit, `[Cleave]` |
| `STACKER` | `giga-stacker` | 1/1 Unit, `[Stack]` |
| `LANE_ONLY` | `giga-lane-only` | 1/5 Unit, `attacked_only_from_lane` |
| `REBORN_GIGA` | `giga-reborn` | 1/1 Unit, `[GIGA, Reborn]` |
| `GROWER` | `giga-grower` | 2/2 Unit costing `{"base":0,"embiggen":1}`, whose `conditional_keywords` gives GIGA when embiggened (copy Siege Tank's) |

The tests go in `crates/engine/tests/rules/giga.rs`, with E3's `board`, `play_zones` and `offers` helpers. Give every field entry an explicit `lane`.

- `r3546000_a_giga_is_offered_only_the_left_lanes_where_it_fits`: with `PLAIN` at 3, units 1 and 4.
- `r3546000_a_played_giga_fills_four_zones_and_nothing_enters_them`: after a play at 2, the four zones are not empty, `PLAIN` is offered 1, 4 and 5, and a summon of `PLAIN` at lane 3 places nothing.
- `r3546000_a_giga_summon_takes_the_leftmost_fit_or_fails`: with PLAINs at 2 and 4, nothing lands; with `PLAIN` at 1, it lands at 2.
- `r3546000_a_giga_field_spell_fills_the_unit_zones_of_its_lanes`: in backrow 1, `PLAIN` is offered 3–5.
- `r3546000_nothing_stacks_onto_a_giga`.
- `r3546001_cleave_on_a_giga_hits_the_units_beside_both_its_lanes`: PLAINs at 1 and 4 each take 3.
- `r3546001_a_cleave_beside_a_giga_hits_it_once`.
- `r3546001_only_units_in_this_lane_admits_a_giga_from_either_lane`: the GIGA at 1 may attack `LANE_ONLY` at P2 lane 2, not lane 3.
- `r3546001_a_lane_read_finds_a_giga_in_both_lanes_of_its_row`: `occupant_at`, `lanes_of`, `lane_is_empty`.
- `r3546001_a_giga_attacks_once`.
- `r3546002_a_hand_card_given_giga_plays_into_four_zones_and_a_bounce_ends_it`: `grant_keyword_cards` with `{"scope":{"zones":["hand"]},"keyword":{"kind":"GIGA"}}`.
- `r3546002_an_embiggened_grower_is_giga_and_a_normal_one_is_not`: anchors 1–4 versus lanes 1–5.
- `r3546002_vanilla_and_a_grant_on_the_field_change_no_size`.
- `r3546003_a_rotation_carries_a_giga_whole_or_bounces_it`: right rotation; lane 1 goes to 2; lane 4 goes to its controller's hand.
- `r3546003_a_stolen_giga_needs_four_free_zones`.
- `r3546003_a_reborn_giga_returns_into_its_four_zones`.
- `r3546004_the_view_draws_a_giga_at_its_anchor`: `view_for(P2)` shows the flag at the anchor and `None` in the three covered zones.

The web tests go in `apps/web/src/game/giga.test.tsx`, `describe("R3546004 a GIGA permanent drawn across its four zones")`, using `baseView`, `emptySide`, `unit`, `faceUpBackrow` and `renderBoard`:
- `it("R3546004 your GIGA unit's zone is the anchor and its three others are covered")`
- `it("R3546004 an enemy GIGA field spell covers its unit zones")`
- `it("R3546004 a unit holding the GIGA keyword renders with no chip for it")`

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules giga`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/giga.test.tsx src/game/Board.test.tsx src/cards/keywordVisuals.test.tsx src/cards/rules.test.ts`

## Done when

- [ ] These tests, the engine's, the touched web files' and the full workspace `ts` test pass, with the wire diff committed into the tree.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, clippy, `catalog check`, `patches check` and `fuzz --seeds 200` pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` reports nothing about R3546.
- [ ] The report says GIGA opens no prompt, so the AI, the random policy and the timeout have nothing new to answer.
- [ ] No catalog or script change.

## Risks

- **Replays.** Every new field is skipped when `None`, and the rotation's second pass is empty without a GIGA, so hashes and the golden fold hold.
- **Lost cards.** Every mover checks the fit before it removes a card. The `summon_existing` probe must match the placed card.
- **The `probe`/`stamped` call sites.** They change only `embiggened`, and the zone functions never read Equip (Jilliax), so nothing shipped moves.
- **Speed.** `is_empty` is hot, so `covering` stays a few indexed reads.
- **The base is red for reasons outside this work.**
  - `cargo jackioh spec check` reports 238 problems on 52d311799a: R3535000–R3535002 have no notes (#3535), and R3539000's `proven_in` is wrong.
  - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` fails in 29 files.
  - Report both by name and add nothing to either.

## Open questions

- **A person must post the screenshot** the issue asks for, since the bot has no GitHub access. The builder takes it with `ui-walkthrough` if a board holding S+ #106 Spectre can be set up, and says where it saved it.
- **Shipped scripts that read a lane through `card_at`** (Classic #71 Lane Eater, the designer's "lane eated") see a GIGA in its anchor lane only. Moving them onto `occupant_at` is a later card part's job.
- **S24's "summon … make them GIGA"** needs a summon rider, which this does not build.
- **The GIGA chip and icon** are S26's.
